name: @automa/desktop

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node build/copy-preload.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never

description: Local-first desktop app that fills out job applications on your own machine.
